retrievalProfile.description: A satirical underwater scene featuring a man swimming toward a food item on a fishing hook, mimicking iconic 90s grunge album layouts with high-contrast blue water and bottom-aligned typography.
triggerTerms: man swimming toward donut on hook

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body underwater shot of a man with dark curly hair and glasses, swimming horizontally with arms outstretched toward a glazed donut suspended on a fishing line. The scene is set in a bright blue pool with visible surface ripples and light refraction, featuring bold black text at the bottom separated by a horizontal rule.
coreVisualRelationships: Man centered horizontally in the upper half of the frame
Donut on a hook acting as the visual lure on the right side
Deep blue negative space in the lower third providing a canvas for text
Light rays and surface distortion creating a sense of depth
coreInvariants: Underwater swimming pose with outstretched arms
A food item on a fishing hook as the focal point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The swimmer is centered in the upper two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The donut on the fishing hook serves as the primary point of interaction and visual tension.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the swimmer's reach from left to right toward the donut, then drops down to the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The lower third of the image is a solid, darker blue gradient providing a clean area for typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and tan (donut and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues; high value at the surface with deep shadows in the lower depths.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed Serif and Heavy Oblique Sans
letterConstructionRules: Primary line uses a high-contrast, ultra-condensed serif with vertical stress
Secondary line uses a heavy, italicized sans-serif with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal rule separating the two lines of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a formal, condensed serif and a playful, heavy sans-serif.

avoid: Centered text in the middle of the image

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Onyx or Bodoni Extra Bold Condensed
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, narrow serif look of the primary text.
Captures the weight and slant of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an underwater photograph of a man with curly hair and glasses swimming toward a glazed donut on a fishing hook. The water should be bright blue with surface ripples and light rays. Leave the bottom third of the image as a dark blue gradient with no objects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of black text at the bottom. The top line should be a large, condensed serif font. Place a thin black horizontal line below it. The bottom line should be a heavy, italicized sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the man swimming toward a donut?
Is the water a vibrant blue?
Is the text positioned in the lower third?
Is there a horizontal line between the two text blocks?

adjustableVariables: Type of food on the hook
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Verify the donut is clearly attached to a fishing line
Ensure the swimmer's pose looks natural for underwater movement
Check that the text is solid black and legible against the blue
Confirm the horizontal rule is present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Underwater Subject] + [Absurd Lure] + [High-Contrast Blue Environment] + [Bottom-Weighted Dual-Font Typography].
